listItems: When you convert or promote an Air Gap Protect Infrequent Access copy to a primary copy, all other copies associated with the storage policy are automatically disabled. Once disabled, you cannot re-enable these copies.
During plan creation, Serverless Log Backups are enabled by default for newly created plans.
Azure Blob Storage in Air Gap Protect
If you use the older Hot GRS license, you will see Frequent Access (Multi-Region).
If you use the new license, you will see Frequent Access (without "Multi-Region").
